name: Dark Presence grants the caster spell haste (#3908)
contract: Dark Presence 300957 has two effects: effect 0 is APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID, effect 65) with SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS (aura 216) BasePoints 2 (real 3%), and effect 1 is a plain APPLY_AURA with the same aura/value applied directly to the caster ('In addition, increases your spell haste by 3%' in the tooltip). SpellAuras.cpp's generic area-aura target list always includes the aura owner for the raid/party case, so the caster receives both effect 0 (through the raid AoE, which includes its own source) and effect 1 (the explicit personal bonus) - two separate 3% SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS instances that compound multiplicatively (1/1.03/1.03 =~ 0.9426), matching the tooltip's own 'in addition' wording. The harness has no action to form a party/raid, so the raid-wide propagation to OTHER members and its spell_group 2000182 non-stacking rule (SpellMgr.cpp, cross-checked against data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260908_05_guardian_completion.sql) are not independently re-exercised here - only the code read in the verification pass covers them. Learning is a passive-flagged spell, so it auto-applies the self-aura; aura_amount and spell_cast_time_ms are read/queried directly.

steps.label: Frostbolt cast time before Dark Presence
Effect 0 (raid AoE, which includes the caster) grants 3% spell haste
Effect 1 grants a further 3% spell haste directly to the caster
Both effects compound to roughly a 5.7% faster cast time
